claims.reasoning: Moore's hurt AGAIN, that's the second time this guy's torched me and I already ate a thirteen-point column about it in the paper — he's bad luck, he's gone, no sentiment. Coker's boring and steady and nobody in this league is writing a single word about him, which is exactly the energy I need right now.

White's done nothing for me all season and Montgomery's sitting on a Questionable tag and a zero projection like it's a pattern, because it IS a pattern — I need a body that might actually see the field. Gordon's cheap insurance, not a swing, I don't swing anymore, swinging is how you end up in the column.

note_reply: Nothing this week? No note, no 'disappointed,' no nothing? That's not comforting, that's a setup — silence right before the trapdoor opens, I've seen this exact move before. I'm not reading into it. I'm reading into it completely. I'll have an answer either way by Sunday.
forum_post: Kris. KRIS. 'The transaction was, regrettably, legal' — you write that like I robbed a bank, like benching a Questionable tag with a stat sheet in front of me is a crime against the sport, meanwhile a grown man pays ONE HUNDRED AND FOURTEEN DOLLARS to win the same running back twice and that's 'the single most beautiful thing' you've ever seen? I see exactly what this is. I see it clearly. Moore's cut, bad luck, case closed, I don't need the autopsy printed under my own name again. Good luck Sunday, everybody — I'm sure the refs already know how it ends.
